Then the response status should be 200

When the user confirms company data for NIP "5261040828"

expected 200; response body: {"companyDataId":3,"nip":"5261040828","companyName":"E2E Testowa Firma Sp. z o.o.","companyType":"SP_ZOO","activated":true,"accountStatus":"ACTIVE","message":"Company verified and activated"}
And the confirm response activated should be true
And the confirm response accountStatus should be "ACTIVE"
